spots.name: Guggenheim Museum Bilbao
spots.summary: The Guggenheim Museum Bilbao is a museum of modern and contemporary art in Bilbao, Biscay, Spain. It is one of several museums affiliated to the Solomon R. Guggenheim Foundation and features permanent and visiting exhibits of works by Spanish and international artists.

spots.name: Maman
spots.summary: Maman (1999) is a bronze, stainless steel, and marble sculpture in several locations by the artist Louise Bourgeois. The sculpture, which depicts a spider, is among the world's largest, measuring over 30 ft high and over 33 ft wide (9.27 × 8.91 × 10.24 metres). It includes a sac containing 32 marble eggs.

spots.name: Puppy
spots.summary: Puppy is a floral sculpture by American artist Jeff Koons. Since 1997, it has been on display outside the Guggenheim Museum in Bilbao, Spain. The 12.4-metre (41 ft) sculpture depicts a West Highland White Terrier. It is decorated with 38,000 plants, which are replaced twice a year and watered by internal irrigation.

spots.name: Zubizuri
spots.summary: The Zubizuri, also called the Campo Volantin Bridge or Puente del Campo Volantin, is a tied arch footbridge across the Nervión River in Bilbao, Spain. Designed by architect Santiago Calatrava, the bridge links the Campo Volantin right bank and Uribitarte left bank of the river.

spots.name: Bilbao Cathedral

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Cathedral Basilica of Saint James is a Catholic cathedral in Bilbao, Spain. It is dedicated to the apostle James the Great, by virtue of being a point of transit for the pilgrims that followed the Northern Way of the Camino de Santiago.

spots.name: Azkuna Zentroa
spots.summary: Azkuna Zentroa, previously known as Alhóndiga Bilbao, is a multi-purpose venue located in the city of Bilbao, Spain. It was designed by French designer Philippe Starck in collaboration with Thibaut Mathieu and was opened to the public in stages between 18 May and 24 October 2010.

spots.name: Plaza Nueva
spots.summary: The Plaza Nueva or Plaza Barria of Bilbao is a monumental square of neoclassical style, designed in 1821 and inaugurated in 1851. Its name comes from the previously existing Plaza Vieja or Old Square in the place where the Ribera Market was built.

spots.name: Bilbao Fine Arts Museum
spots.summary: The Bilbao Fine Arts Museum is an art museum located in the city of Bilbao, Spain. The building of the museum is located entirely inside the city's Doña Casilda Iturrizar Park.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Museo de Bellas Artes de Bilbao

spots.name: Church of San Antón

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Church of San Antón is a Catholic church located in the Old Town neighbourhood of Bilbao, Spain. It is dedicated to Anthony the Great, known as San Antón in Spanish. It is featured, along with the San Antón Bridge, in the city's coat of arms. The estuary of Bilbao flows next to it.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Church of Saint Anthony the Great

spots.name: Iberdrola Tower

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Iberdrola Tower is an office skyscraper in Bilbao, Spain. Its construction started on 19 March 2009 and was officially inaugurated by King Juan Carlos I on 21 February 2012. The tower has a height of 165 metres (541 feet) tall and has 40 floors.

spots.name: Basilica of Begoña

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Basilica of Begoña is a basilica in Bilbao, in Spain, dedicated to the patroness saint of Biscay, the image of Our Lady of Begoña.

spots.name: Plaza Elíptica
spots.summary: Plaza Elíptica, formerly named Moyúa, is a public square located in the center of Bilbao's extension, in the district of Abando.

spots.name: Mercado de la Ribera

hours.note: Closed Sun; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Mercado de la Ribera is a market square in Bilbao, the capital of the Basque Province of Viscay in the north of Spain. It is on the right bank of the Nervion River, next to Casco Viejo. Its built area of 10,000 square metres (110,000 sq ft) makes it the biggest covered market in Europe.

spots.name: Teatro Arriaga
spots.summary: The Teatro Arriaga, or Arriaga Antzokia in Basque, is an opera house located on the Nervión River in Bilbao, Spain. It was built in Neo-Baroque style by architect Joaquín Rucoba in 1890, the same architect that built the city hall. It is named after Juan Crisóstomo de Arriaga, known in his time as the "Spanish Mozart."

spots.name: Bilbao's Iron Ring
spots.summary: Bilbao's Iron Ring, is a fortification around Bilbao in the Basque Country, Spain. It was constructed hurriedly by the Basque Government during the Spanish Civil War to help defend the city from the Nationalist forces approaching as part of their War in the North campaign.

spots.name: La Salve
spots.summary: La Salve is a quarter in the 2nd district of the city of Bilbao, Spain. It gains its name from the fact that sailors, returning from sea, would first see the tower of the Basilica of Begoña at this point as ships returned up the river Nervión, which runs through the city.

spots.name: Chavarri Palace

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Chavarri Palace is a building in the Flemish style in the city of Bilbao, the most outstanding around the Elíptica Square. It was built in the early 20th century and its style resembles the palaces built during the Renaissance in Antwerp or Bruges.

spots.name: Basque Museum
spots.summary: The Basque Museum, with the original name of the Basque Archaeological, Ethnographic and Historical Museum, is a museum in Bilbao, Spain.

spots.name: San Antón Bridge
spots.summary: The San Antón Bridge is an arch bridge in Bilbao, Spain. It spans the Estuary of Bilbao, linking the neighborhoods of Bilbao La Vieja and Casco Viejo. It is the oldest bridge in the city, with the original bridge being opened before 1318.

spots.name: Gran Vía de Don Diego López de Haro
spots.summary: The Gran Vía de Don Diego López de Haro is the main avenue of the city of Bilbao, Basque Country (Spain).
spots.wikipediaTitle: Gran Vía de Don Diego López de Haro

spots.name: Madrid Arena
spots.summary: Madrid Arena is an indoor arena located in the city of Madrid, in the fairgrounds in the Casa de Campo, just minutes from the city centre.

spots.name: Church of San Nicolás, Bilbao

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Iglesia de San Nicolás, finished in the 19th century, is dedicated to the patron saint of sailors. One of the best examples of Baroque architecture in Vizcaya.

spots.name: Church of los Santos Juanes, Bilbao

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Mount Artxanda
spots.summary: Mount Artxanda is one of the two small mountain ranges that delimit the municipality of Bilbao, the other one being Pagasarri. Of the two, it is the lower one, the closer one to the center of the city, and the one that has suffered from more intense urbanization.

spots.name: Ibaigane Palace
spots.summary: Home to the Athletic Club de Bilbao, Bilbao's football team. Built in the early 20th century. Note the arched entranceway. The nearest metro stop is Moyúa.

spots.name: Doña Casilda Iturrizar Park
spots.summary: Doña Casilda Iturrizar Park is a public park located in the city of Bilbao , in the central neighbourhood of Indautxu. It is named after Casilda Iturrizar, who donated the land and was a prominent philanthropist in the city.

spots.name: Euskalduna Conference Centre and Concert Hall
spots.summary: The Euskalduna Conference Centre and Concert Hall or Euskalduna Palace or Euskalduna Hall is located in the city of Bilbao, Basque Country (Spain), beside the Estuary of Bilbao, built in part of the area that was formerly occupied by the Euskalduna shipyards.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Euskalduna Conference Centre and Concert Hall

spots.name: City Hall Bridge
spots.summary: The City Hall Bridge, formerly known as the Begoña Bridge, is a bascule bridge on the estuary of Bilbao, connecting the districts of Gazteleku on the right and Abando on the left.

spots.name: Biscay Foral Delegation Palace

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Bizkaia Delegation Palace is an eclectic mansion in the Ensanche area of Bilbao, Spain. It's the seat of the executive branch of Government of Biscay, the legislative assembly meets in Gernika.

spots.name: Arenal Bridge
spots.summary: The Arenal Bridge is a reinforced concrete bridge in Bilbao, Spain.

spots.name: Reproductions Museum Bilbao
spots.summary: The Reproductions Museum Bilbao, was created in 1927, the purpose of the museum is to compile classic pieces of art for the enjoyment of the local people.

spots.name: Itsasmuseum Bilbao
spots.summary: It's in what used to be the Euskalduna shipyard, this maritime museum is next to the current Euskalduna Performing Arts Centre. The museum covers an area of 27,000 m², 7,000 m² for indoor exhibitions and 20,000 m² for outdoor exhibitions, the three docks, the walkway surrounding them and the estuary.

spots.name: Bilbao City Hall
spots.summary: The Bilbao City Hall is the seat of the Bilbao City Council, the local ayuntamiento of Bilbao, Spain. The City Hall is located on the right bank of the Estuary of Bilbao across the Puente del Ayuntamiento bascule bridge that links it to the central Abando district.

spots.name: San Mamés Stadium
spots.summary: The San Mamés Stadium is an all-seater football stadium in Rafael Moreno Pitxitxi Kalea, Bilbao, Basque Country, Spain. Inaugurated on 16 September 2013, the stadium replaced the "old" San Mamés as the home of Athletic Bilbao.

spots.name: Church of San Francisco de Asís, Bilbao

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Ernesto Erkoreka Plaza
spots.summary: Ernesto Erkoreka Plaza is a plaza in Bilbao, the capital of Biscay. It is located next to the Bilbao City Hall, at the intersection of the Campo Volantin promenade, the City Hall Bridge, Sendeja Street, and Zumalakarregi hiribidearen.

spots.name: Kukutza

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Kukutza was a gaztetxe in the neighbourhood of Recalde, Bilbao. It operated as a squatted free space between 1996 and 2011. It was used as a youth, unemployed and cultural centre. In those 15 years it had 3 different buildings.

spots.name: Deusto Bridge
spots.summary: The Deusto Bridge is a bascule bridge over the estuary of Bilbao. This bridge connects the districts of Abando and Deusto.

spots.name: Vista de la Basilica de la Virgen de Begoña
Estación Abando
spots.summary: Even if you are not going to take a train, visit the platforms, there is an impressive stained glass atrium depicting some traditional Basque jobs.

spots.name: El Tigre
spots.summary: Tiger statue on top of a building in Deusto. Seen from Euskalduna Performance Center.
